backends.GPTL: Direct C GPTL API; options print_method/full_tree, abort_on_error=1, overhead=0; only initialize return is checked, exactly as Native.
backends.cpu_time: Process CPU time in core-kind seconds; dynamic registry, strict LIFO stack, recursive same-name regions allowed.

state: Private thread_local initialized/enabled, registry/stack and logical counts mirror Native OpenMP threadprivate; expressly authorized exception to no globals.
preserved_semantics: disabled operations return without validation; initialize reenables
start initializes lazily; stop before initialization fails
initialize requires empty CPU stack; disable discards an active stack
stop reads time and looks up name before empty-stack/nesting checks
insertion-order counts, inclusive time, exclusive time minus immediate children
finalize validates filename and announces path before CPU active-stack check
filename/name trim removes trailing blanks only; no normalization
PWD relative-path resolution and fixed1024 character assignment/truncation
same table headers, widths, precision, footer and no-timer output
all Native diagnostics and checks, no Kokkos dependency or GPU synchronization
adaptations_planned: std::clock/CLOCKS_PER_SEC maps Native process cpu_time; unavailable clock maps to -1 second
std::vector resized by Native16/32 increments represents allocatable slots; separate1-based timer IDs and logical counts
private ostream replaces Native integer output unit; file is local and truncating
timer_fail throws Native-prefixed runtime_error for existing standalone catch
C strings at GPTL boundary; same trailing-blank trim
C++ fixed-format numeric fields retain Native widths/precision; overflows rendered as stars
validation_scope: Source/control/argument/comment/format review only; Root owns compilation, GPTL/CPU edge checks, maintained model comparisons and utility execution.
promotion: Permanent implementation is under src/CLUBB_core; draft source snapshots archived locally under build/validation/timers_cpp/promoted_draft.
